what: Right-padding probe. models.py:generate_latent_batch seeds the latent thought from hidden_states[-1][:, -1, :] -- position -1 of a RIGHT-padded batch -- and then builds latent_mask=torch.ones(...), un-masking every pad already in the KV cache. Invisible at bs=1.
config: Qwen3-4B / MBPP+ / sequential / latent_steps=10 / max_new_tokens=4096 / think=1 / L40S / seed 42
conclusion: Padding costs ~18 accuracy points (55.6 -> 37.8). But bs=1 is still 22 points under the single-agent baseline on the same 45 problems, so the latent channel itself costs more than padding does. Fixing padding does not rescue the arm.
